verdict.rationale: Publishing guidance on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments is a fair question for a startup-focused law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a general Startup Resource Center and US-centric equity-compensation work (409A, 162(m), 280G), with seven US offices and no international ones. Nothing in the pack covers UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE or any other non-US startup instruments.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE
